metadata.explanation: Chains the solved fullscreen goal with a VLC preferences sub-goal (max volume). Evaluator reads VLC window size for fullscreen (0.5) and reads qt-max-volume from ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc (0.5). Default is 125; setting to 150 changes the saved preference. Initial state fails both checks (not fullscreen, volume=125), so it is negative-control resistant. llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator covers both instruction sub-goals: fullscreen state and max volume limit set to 150%.
Fullscreen check uses window-size vs screen-size comparison via standard OSWorld controller API, which is a reliable and commonly accepted proxy for VLC fullscreen mode.
Max volume check correctly reads qt-max-volume from /home/user/.config/vlc/vlcrc, which is the standard VLC config file and the correct setting for the GUI max volume slider.
The getter correctly skips commented lines (lines starting with '#') when parsing vlcrc, ensuring only active settings are read.
Partial credit scoring (0.5 + 0.5) is appropriate for this two-goal chained task.
Negative-control resistant: initial state has VLC not in fullscreen and qt-max-volume=125 (default), so both checks fail at baseline.
Expected value '150' in evaluator.expected.rules.expected_max_volume correctly matches the instruction requirement.

The fix history shows the 8-char MD5 suffix was corrected to the full 32-char hash; the actual getter/metric Python files now use the correct ecd5fecf55729059a58a10d83c8c9eeb suffix. Rule validation errors in metadata are stale pre-fix records.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: The rule_validation_passed and validation_passed fields in metadata.validation are stale (reflect pre-fix state). Consider re-running rule validation after the MD5 fix to update these fields.
